controls.name: cockpit_throttle
controls.label: REVERSE / SPEED
controls.action: signed speed request; forward 12 or 27.777778 m/s, reverse 5 m/s

controls.name: cockpit_brake
controls.label: BRAKE
controls.action: proportional reduction of speed request to zero

controls.name: cockpit_emergency
controls.label: PARK / STOP
controls.action: latched zero-speed request; press again to release

scope: Finite-effort physical controls mapped to current vehicle functions. Robot reach and contact affordances supplied; no trained Sai manipulation policy.
